requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque production terrain tile spritesheet for the Greek mythology top-down pixel-art roguelite Paradise in Hell. Input image is ONLY the established stone/pixel-art texture style reference, NOT a layout to copy. Create ONE NEW fully OPAQUE square1536x1536 PNG, EXACT invisible THREE-column THREE-row grid, nine equal512square cells, no gutters or margins. Every pixel covered by artwork. Nine independent TOP-DOWN tile textures, viewed straight down, no horizon or oblique camera. Crisp painted pixel clusters, restrained low-frequency stone texture, no fine noisy speckles. NO painted grid/outer border, labels, numbers, text, visible panel separators or framing. All nine cells meet exactly at canvas thirds. Row0 (TOP): three QUIET seamless WALKABLE FLOOR variations numbered floor0/1/2 in code only (draw NO numbers): broad worn paving stones with very low contrast, same material, same value and matching neutral edges. Each individual floor tile must tile seamlessly on all four edges, and mix with the other two without obvious seams. These base tiles will cover at least95%of gameplay floor, so keep them calm and unobtrusive behind enemies and projectiles. Row1 (MIDDLE): three SOLID SQUARE BLOCKED OBSTACLE TOP SURFACES, obstacle0/1/2: heavy cut-stone masonry masses visibly distinct from walkable paving. Their solid stone footprint MUST cover the ENTIRE square cell, at least95%area; full square corners, no gaps showing floor. Broad top-down stone mass with a restrained heavy rim on the edges, no tall side face, column, pillar, round boulder, perspective tower, arch or raised object leaving invisible corners. Nothing extends outside its square. These are completely solid16worldpixel square collision blocks. Row2 (BOTTOM): three rare DECORATED WALKABLE FLOOR variations floor3/4/5: subtle FLAT engravings, worn small Greek meander detail, tiny patches of dry dirt or moss consistent with theme. Decoration is painted FLAT into floor, no raised rubble, object, trap, hazard, lava, glowing rune, spikes, pit or anything suggesting blocked terrain. These decorations will be used at most5%of floor; still restrained and low contrast. Preserve a coherent neutral-stone base and seamless neutral edges in all floor cells. Keep floor calmer than actors; block tops have clearer material/mass but no warning colors. No characters, weapons, pickups, monsters, particle sparks, water pools, neon, strong light bloom, directional arrow or tactical attack marker. Theme identity: Safe underworld refuge: warm neutral grey limestone and faint warm brown stone, very restrained antique bronze flecks embedded FLAT, welcoming muted warmth. No orange/yellow glow. Basefloor broad smooth calm slabs, decoratedfloor small worn olive/meander engraving, blocktops warm grey squared masonry.
